Message.Name: Best Bid And Offer Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq's internal view of the National Best Bid and Offer, used with OUCH to prevent trade-throughs and quote-throughs. For this feed, the only message type is "U".

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The price on the bid with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. The decimal point is implied by position; it does not appear inside the price field. The price is padded with spaces on the left.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The price on the ask with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. The decimal point is implied by position; it does not appear inside the price field. The price is padded with spaces on the left.
